footsteps on different surfaces (footsteps_0.zip) - https://opengameart.org/content/footsteps-on-different-surfaces
Folders used: gravel (CC0, derived from Ali_6868's Gravel Footsteps pack), boots (CC-BY 3.0, derived from swuing's footstep-concrete.wav),
water (CC-BY 3.0, derived from EminYILDIRIM's Water Footsteps and swuing's footstep-concrete.wav). Per-folder license texts are beside this file.
-> Assets/Resources/Audio/Footsteps/gravel/, boots/, water/, bunker/, stone/, interior/
bunker (CC-BY 3.0, modified 2026-11-27): each of the 9 boots clips (swuing footstep-concrete.wav) with Kenney Impact Sounds footstep_concrete (CC0) high-passed and mixed in very quietly (gain 0.06) 35 ms before it as a faint heel tap - used for the shelter floor. License: same as license_boots.txt.
stone (CC-BY 3.0, modified 2026-11-28): each of the 9 boots clips pitched up 7%, with Kenney footstep_concrete (CC0, high-passed at 900 Hz, gain 0.32) 22 ms before it and a 60 ms high-passed (2.5 kHz) slice of Fantozzi stone footsteps (CC0, gain 0.07) - used for city sidewalks, lots and roofs. License: same as license_boots.txt.
interior (CC-BY 3.0, modified 2026-11-28): Kenney footstep_concrete (CC0) followed 18 ms later by a boots clip low-passed at 1.8 kHz, plus a short (0.3 s) small-concrete-room reverb - used for building floors. License: same as license_boots.txt.
